criteria.description: A bounded TDD and verification plan is frozen for source, worker and disposable process tests, including strict filters, tenant isolation, signed raw values, overflow and non-PII audit handling.

gaps: The scheduled movement source, worker branch/bootstrap wiring, RED/GREEN tests and real process proof do not exist at gate creation.
Persisted movement fields are reported as operational ledger facts only; Vetus event interpretation, lots, consumption reconstruction, invoice/NF and historical valuation remain outside scope.
Independent review, global non-promotion retest, hygiene and final bounded reconciliation remain required.
conditions: Keep the result limited to the authenticated tenant-scoped scheduled read path over inventory_stock_movements plus same-account inventory_items labels and the exact thirteen-field contract.

Do not add migrations, writes, lot/consumption reconstruction, fiscal/NF semantics, historical valuation, API/SPA changes, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill or release acceptance.
Keep CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation of the consolidation request and original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled inventory movement ledger report through the real worker
authority.decision: Authorize only reversible inventory-module and worker implementation plus focused/disposable PostgreSQL and process verification of the existing raw persisted inventory_stock_movements operational ledger joined to same-account inventory_items. Preserve the exact thirteen fields, strict case-insensitive search/date filters, deterministic occurredAt DESC/movementId ASC order, 10,000-row bound, tenant context and durable schedule/audit/one-shot semantics. Exclude lot or consumption reconstruction, Vetus event interpretation, as-of or historical valuation, fiscal/NF, API/SPA changes, migrations/backfill, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing inventory movement/item schema, RLS or numeric/timestamp semantics, adding fields/joins/filters, changing schedule/audit behavior, adding fiscal/historical/lot/consumption interpretation, provider delivery, target operations or production behavior.

next_action: Write and run the intentional inventory-movements source, worker and real process RED tests, then implement the smallest bounded tenant-aware persisted source and PostgreSQL proof.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to inventory_stock_movements/inventory_items schema, account RLS/FORCE-RLS or persisted movement numeric/timestamp semantics
Changes to worker bootstrap, schedule claiming, report execution/export/audit or one-shot failure behavior
Expansion beyond scheduled inventory-movements or the existing thirteen-field raw ledger contract
